text.title: FreshDrop order, from placed to delivered
text.entity: A grocery order. The lifecycle starts when the buyer pays and ends at delivery or refund
text.scope: Events from the app, the warehouse system and the courier app. Payment internals are outside the model
text.s1: paid: money captured, the order waits for assembly
text.s2: assembling: a picker collects items in the dark store
text.s3: assembled: all items packed and weighed
text.s4: handed to courier: the order left the store
text.s5: on the way: the courier is driving to the address
text.s6: at the door: the courier arrived and waits for the buyer
text.s7: pending check: the buyer checks the items
text.e1: completed: the buyer accepted the order
text.e2: refunded: cancelled or returned, money back
text.t8: item complaint [within 24 h] → back to assembling for the missing item
text.tc: cancel: buyer [before assembly], support [no courier 2 h]
text.t2: assembly done [all items found or replaced]
text.forbidden: paid → on the way; pending check → assembling; refunded → any state
text.gaps: No state for «buyer unreachable»: support handles it by phone, outside the model
text.decision: 7 states and the refund branch agreed with dev and support, recorded in the PRD; «buyer unreachable» state scheduled for the next release
